issue.title: Choose a consistent singular or plural noun policy for Bob command groups
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-46.3 note #3; explicitly deferred in plan:202610/bob_command_tree.md. projects and plugins are plural, task and pomodoro singular. Inventory current groups, choose a noun policy with Bryan, and implement only an approved compatible migration. Preserve all old command spellings as permanent silent aliases, section and completion parity, and the stated narrow task membership rule. Frozen capture-* subprocess names are excluded. The current names are accepted behavior, not a regression introduced by bob-cli-46.

task_type_fields.proposal: Choose and document a singular/plural policy for Bob noun groups and, if approved, migrate affected groups with permanent silent aliases.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Noun-policy normalization is an R8 recommendation explicitly deferred by bob-cli-46.3; changing the accepted projects/plugins/task tree was not part of this epic.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-46.3 note #3 records the explicitly deferred R8 noun-policy recommendation. A policy and compatible migration need their own plan rather than extending this epic.
